Noah Rivera: Heads-up — NebulaLedger onboarding: p95 tail ~2.2s on their dedicated pool during peak and token spend ~2.0x forecast. Renewal ~33 days. Proposing a short pilot: 8-bit quantized model swap + route long requests to their dedicated pool with probabilistic sampling. Need eng + SRE + enablement.

Aisha Khan: please share perf link and an example trace.

Noah Rivera: dash: https://redwood.app/d/nebulaledger/ops?panelId=tailing
trace: `req=nlg-314 seq=1..640 p50=90ms p95=2.2s model=redwood/archer-11b`

Tom Becker: propose arch-11b-int8 for canary and enable prefix caching for repeated invoice prompts. Estimate ~35% token cost reduction and lower scheduler backlog.

Noah Rivera: dropping canary config. cc @Mira for enablement slot.

Tom Becker: ```{"selector": "customer_id == \"nebulaledger\" && sample_rate < 0.12",
 "model": "redwood/archer-11b-int8",
 "pool": "dedicated-nebulaledger-us-central",
 "prefix_cache": {"enabled": true, "ttl_minutes": 30},
 "max_concurrency": 80,
 "fallback": "redwood/archer-11b",
 "monitoring": {"slo_p95_ms": 1200}
}```

Mira Ops: I can run a 45-min enablement session: 10m infra, 20m canary ops, 15m customer comms. Available Mon/Tue next week.

TelemetryBot: [alert] nebula_prod_avg_seq_len +14% last 24h, token_rate +10%. Created ticket CS-3221.

Liam SRE: I can reserve a 1-GPU slot on dedicated-nebulaledger-us-central for a 48h canary. Need IAM list and expected peak rps.

Tom Becker: peak ~310 rps, steady ~130. IAM: noah@redwood, aisha@redwood, tom@redwood. I'll stage canary and smoke tests once slot is up.

Noah Rivera: I'll draft a customer note summarizing pilot goals (p95 tail smoothing + cost delta) and a renewal blurb with conservative vs optimistic savings. Sharing for review before sending.

Aisha Khan: please include rollback criteria and how we'll measure success (p95 delta, error parity, token-cost). Thanks all :thumbsup:
